title: hostgroup.get
description: Retrieve host groups according to the given parameters.

graphids.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with the given graphs.

groupids.description: Return only host groups with the given host group IDs.

hostids.description: Return only host groups that contain the given hosts.

maintenanceids.description: Return only host groups that are affected by the given maintenances.

triggerids.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with the given triggers.

with_graphs.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with graphs.

with_graph_prototypes.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with graph prototypes.

with_hosts.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts.

with_httptests.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with web checks. Overrides the with_monitored_httptests parameter.

with_items.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with items. Overrides the with_monitored_items and with_simple_graph_items parameters.

with_item_prototypes.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with item prototypes. Overrides the with_simple_graph_item_prototypes parameter.

with_simple_graph_item_prototypes.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with item prototypes, which are enabled for creation and have numeric type of information.

with_monitored_httptests.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with enabled web checks.

with_monitored_hosts.description: Return only host groups that contain monitored hosts.

with_monitored_items.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with enabled items. Overrides the with_simple_graph_items parameter.

with_monitored_triggers.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with enabled triggers. All of the items used in the trigger must also be enabled.

with_simple_graph_items.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with numeric items.

with_triggers.description: Return only host groups that contain hosts with triggers. Overrides the with_monitored_triggers parameter.

selectDiscoveryRules.description: Return a discoveryRules property with the LLD rules that discovered the host group. See the Discovery rule object (reference/discoveryrule/object).

selectGroupDiscoveries.description: Return a groupDiscoveries property with the host group discovery objects. Each host group discovery object is a host group prototype linked to the discovered host group and has the following properties: parent_group_prototypeid - (ID) ID of the host group prototype from which the host group was discovered; name - (string) name of the host group prototype; lastcheck - (timestamp) time when the host group was last discovered; ts_delete - (timestamp) time when the host group that is no longer discovered will be deleted; status - (integer) host group discovery status: 0 - (default) host group is discovered, 1 - host group is not discovered anymore.

selectHostPrototypes.description: Return a hostPrototypes property with host prototypes that discovered this host group. See the Host prototype object (reference/hostprototypes/object).

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with the hosts that belong to the host group. See the Host object (reference/host/object). Supports count.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to the following subselects: selectHosts - results will be sorted by host.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: groupid, name.

monitored_hosts.description: Deprecated, use with_monitored_hosts instead. Return only host groups that contain monitored hosts.

real_hosts.description: Deprecated, use with_hosts instead. Return only host groups that contain hosts.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
